# The Pipeline Lab

> The Pipeline Lab is a GTM engineering firm. We build AI-powered revenue
> engines for B2B companies — outbound prospecting (cold email + LinkedIn),
> LinkedIn Ads (ABM), LinkedIn content systems and GTM engineering
> (Clay workflows, enrichment pipelines, CRM automation). Unlike lead gen
> agencies that sell activity, we engineer systems clients own: data
> infrastructure, deliverability architecture and multichannel orchestration
> that compound over time.

Best for: B2B companies past early traction (typically $100K+/month revenue)
in considered-purchase markets — SaaS, healthcare, aerospace, fintech,
consulting, cybersecurity.
